How KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail fares & train types work

  • Two parts to every ticket: a base fare (乗車券, jōshaken) based on distance plus a KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail super-express supplement (特急券, tokkyūken). The figures above combine both.
  • Nozomi & Mizuho trains: the fastest services on the Tokaido, Sanyo, and Kyushu KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail. Nationwide Rail Pass holders can ride them only by purchasing a separate Nozomi/Mizuho supplement ticket, or ride Hikari, Sakura, and Kodama trains at no extra cost.
  • All-reserved trains: Hayabusa, Komachi, Kagayaki, and Tsubasa have no unreserved cars—always book a seat reservation before boarding. See our KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail seat reservation guide.
  • Oversized baggage: suitcases with total dimensions (H+W+D) between 161 cm and 250 cm require an "席特" oversized-baggage seat reservation on the Tokaido, Sanyo, and Kyushu KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail (free with reservation, ₩1,000 fee if brought onboard unbooked). Check your bag in our Luggage Size Checker.
